legacy:B01.caption_original: Figure 7: A generation stall occurs when one or more prefills are scheduled in between consecutive decode iterations of a request. A, B, C and D represent different requests. Subscript d represents a decode iteration, p represents a full prefill and p0, p1 represent two chunked prefills of a given prompt. vLLM induces generation stalls by scheduling as many prefills as possible before resuming ongoing decodes. Despite supporting hybrid batches, Orca cannot mitigate generation stalls because the execution time of batches containing long prompts remains high. FasterTransformer is free of generation stalls as it finishes all ongoing decodes before scheduling a new prefill but compromises on throughput due to low decode batch size. In contrast, Sarathi-Serve generates a schedule that eliminates generation stalls yet delivers high throughput.

legacy:B22.caption_original: Figure 2: Gantt chart of LLM call execution on an LLM serving engine with a max batch size (BS) of 2 (Y-axis) over decoding steps (Xaxis). (a) Four programs vary in the number of LLM calls and decode steps per call. Long programs (A, B) and short programs (C, D) are shown. (b) First-Come First-Served (FCFS) incurs head-of-line blocking as long LLM calls delay short LLM calls, resulting in a waiting time of 18 units. (c) Multilevel Feedback Queue (MLFQ) reduces blocking with preemption but still incurs program-level blocking. Programs A and B’s new LLM calls are placed in the highest priority queue, delaying Program D, incurring 18 units of waiting time. (d) Program-Level Attained Service (PLAS) leverages program-level statistics, delaying subsequent calls in A and B to prioritize programs C and D, reducing waiting time to 12 units.

legacy:B28.caption_original: Figure 2: Overview of different attention sharding strategies. Here we are using GQA as an example with Query heads Q=4 and KV heads K=2. Each block processes one token with context length S. (Left) No TP: all Q and KV heads are co-located on a single GPU; no duplication. (MiddleLeft) TP=2: Query heads are split across 2 GPUs; KV heads are still partitioned cleanly since TP ≤ K. (Middle-Right) TP=4: More shards than KV heads; GPUs must duplicate KV cache to serve their assigned query heads, reintroducing DRAM capacity and bandwidth inefficiencies. (Right) Helix (TP=2, KVP=2): Helix shards the KV cache across sequence length (S) using KVP, so each KVP rank holds only a slice (S/2). By capping TP at K and assigning the remaining GPUs to KVP, Helix avoids duplication and forms a 2D layout: TP splits heads, KVP splits the sequence.

fig:osdi2024-a-tale-of-two-paths-toward-.caption_original: Figure 11: Normalized throughput of Memcached workloads run-ning on Atlas and Atlas-LRU under 25% local memory.Hotness tracking. Atlas uses an access bit on each smartpointer to segregate hot and cold objects during evacua-tion, offering beneﬁts to workloads that exhibit skewness.We evaluated the effectiveness of Atlas’s access bit withthree skewed workloads, i.e., highly-skewed (Meta, MCD-CL) [2], moderately-skewed (Twitter, MCD-TWT) [74] anduniformed without skewnewss (MCD-U) [15]. We comparedAtlas with a baseline (Atlas-LRU) equipped with an LRU-like policy from CacheLib [12], which represents a more ac-curate approach to identifying hotness.As shown in Figure 11, Atlas’s single-bit design outper-forms the LRU-like design by 7.5%, 3.3% and 6.0%, respec-tively. The LRU-like policy trades compute resources foraccuracy by maintaining the logical ordering of objects via alinked list. Each dereference triggers a promotion that movesthe object to the head of the LRU list. In order to reduce theoverhead, we adopted ﬂat combining [30] (to reduce threadlock contention) and ignored the dereferences of an objectwithin 10s (to reduce promotion frequency for extremely hotobjects) [12]. However, although an LRU-like policy can re-duce the frequency of remote access, it incurs a maintenanceoverhead of up to 9% due to a huge number of objects.Of course, the more bits used, the higher accuracy theybring.Atlas allows developers to customize the hotnesstracking policy with the two reserved bits in each smartpointer (Figure 2). For our applications, we did not observesigniﬁcant performance variations between using one andtwo access bits—likely the ability of distinguishing hot andcold objects is not increased much with two access bits.

(a) Karma enables a much tighter throughput distribution across users (coloredarrows show the absolute gap between median and minimum throughput across users). (b, c) It also enables a tighter distributionof average and tail latencies across users (again, colored arrows show the absolute gap between median and maximum latencyacross users). (d) Karma achieves much lower throughput disparity—ratio of median to minimum values of throughput acrossusers—than classic max-min fairness. (e) It also significantly reduces the gap between the users with minimum and maximumoverall allocations, (f) while achieving similar system-wide performance as max-min fairness.

explanation.summary: EiNNet概览把输入张量程序转换成子程序和代数表达式，在表达式层应用推导规则并实例化，再生成变换后的子程序、做后优化，最终输出优化程序。
elements: 左主链从Input tensor program开始，经Program splitter形成三种小DAG子程序，Program translator将它们转为求和/乘加表达式。
Derivation-based optimizer连接右侧Derivation rules框，其中分Intra-expression derivation、Inter-expression derivation和Expression instantiation三个部分。
Transformed subprograms画出含红/橙节点的多个DAG，图例规定红为eOperator、橙为Predefined operator。
Post-optimization位于主链末端，向下生成Optimized tensor program；章节编号帮助对应原文模块。
reading_order: 沿左主链自上而下读输入、分割、表达式翻译，区分程序图与代数表示。
到optimizer时转向右框读三类推导/实例化规则，再返回下方变换DAG。
用红橙图例检查生成节点类型，最后顺着post-optimization到输出，不把右规则框误读成并行执行数据流。

fig:osdi2025-fork-in-the-road-reflection.caption_original: Figure 6: End-to-end latency of cold start. The numbers represent the latency of each phase of a Node.js-based function(nunjucks—rendering the template to HTML), detailed experimental setup can be found in §6. The entire end-to-end start-upprocess consists of three main stages: (1) Control-path Interaction. ①BinaryLoad: The runtime shim [22] loads the Catalyzerengine binary and starts the client process. ②ArgPrepare: The client process prepares fork-related parameters and invokesthe seed sandbox. (2) Container Initialization. ①Clone: The seed sandbox invokes the clone() syscall to fork a new sandbox.②RuntimeRecover: The forked sandbox initializes the Go runtime. ③LogRedirect: The stdout and stderr of the sandbox areredirected. ④CtrlRecreate: The sandbox recreates the control server. ⑤PlatformReload: The sandbox transitions from VMXroot mode to VMX non-root mode. ⑥KernelUnpause: The guest OS is unpaused to resume execution. ⑦NetworkPrepare: Theclient process prepares the network interface and creates a raw socket that binds to this network interface, then sends the rawsocket to the sandbox. ⑧InitStack: The guest OS initializes the network stack. ⑨InstallSeccomp: The sandbox parses and installsa seccomp filter. ⑩Activate: The sandbox is attached to the host cgroups and mounts the rootfs. (3) User Code Execution. ①InitCode: The sandbox loads the appropriate language runtime, compiles the user code, and also loads the function’s dependencyframework and libraries. ②Execute: The sandbox executes user code and provides a response.

fig:osdi2023-ship-your-critical-section-.caption_original: Figure 2: Lock and qnode structures of the TCLock. (a) Initially, thelock is in the unlock state. t1 first switches from its main stack (M1)to the ephemeral stack (E1), and (b) joins the waiting queue. (c) t1being at the head of the queue, becomes the combiner. Meanwhile,t2 and t3 join the queue. They also switch their stack to E2 and E3,respectively. (d) t1 begins the combining process by traversing thequeue and finds t2. (e) t1 switches to t2’s main stack (E1 →M2) andexecutes t2’s critical section. (f) Once finished, t1 first switchesback to E1 and then notifies t2 that t1 has finished executing itscritical section. (g) t2 then switches back to M2 and exits its unlockphase. Meanwhile, t1 finds t3 as the last waiter. (h) t1 notifies t3that it is now at the head of the queue, then t1 switches its stack toM1, executes its critical section, and finally exits the unlock phase.

elements: 左Inference Requests进入Inference Servers，Feature Store向服务器提供Features；服务器向下经Scribe、ETL Jobs进入Hive Table Partition。

explanation.takeaway: 图支持把DLRM训练成本分成日志/存储、reader预处理、训练资源和模型反馈多个环节，便于定位端到端基础设施里的数据接口。

fig:mlsys2024-prompt-cache-modular-atten.caption_original: Figure 2. Reuse mechanism in Prompt Cache: (i) First, PML (§3.2) makes reusable prompt modules explicit in both Schema and Prompt.A prompt module can have parameters like trip-plan. A prompt importing the module supplies a value (3 days) to the parameter(duration). The prompt can include new text segments in place of excluded modules and parameters and at the end. (ii) Second,prompt module encoding (§ 3.3) precomputes attention states ( 1 ) for all modules in the schema and caches them for future reuse. (iii)Third, when the prompt is served, Prompt Cache employs cached inference (§3.4): it retrieves the attention states cached for importedprompt modules ( 2 , computes them for parameters ( 3 ) and new text segments ( 4 ), and finally concatenates them to produce theattention states for the entire prompt ( 5 ). This figure is an elaboration of Step 1 in Figure 1c.

fig:sosp2024-apparate-rethinking-early-e.caption_original: Figure 6. System architecture.Figure 6 overviews Apparate’s workflow, which runs atopexisting serving platforms. Users register inference jobs asnormal 1 , providing models and SLOs without needing anyawareness of or expertise about EEs. In addition, Apparate in-troduces two parameters: (1) ramp aggression, which boundsthe number of active ramps in terms of % impact on worst-case latency (and throughput), and (2) accuracy constraintwhich indicates how much (if any) accuracy loss is acceptablerelative to running the submitted model on all inputs with-out exiting. Apparate’s controller begins by configuring theprovided model with EEs 2 , performing a graph assessmentto determine suitable positions for ramps, and training thoseramps on bootstrap data (§3.1). The resulting model is passedto the serving platform for deployment 3 , after which Ap-parate shifts to management mode. In this phase, as requestsarrive and inference is scheduled, Apparate’s controller gath-ers real-time feedback on the utility of each ramp (overheadsvs. latency savings) and achieved accuracies (relative to theoriginal model) 4 . This data is used to continually adapt theEE configuration 7 at different time scales: rapid thresholdtuning for accuracy preservation (§3.2) 5 , and less frequentramp adjustments for latency optimization (§3.3) 6 .This decoupling of EE configuration adaptation into twotuning control loops is a key design decision that Apparateuses to manage the untenably large search space of ramp-threshold combinations (C1) without substantial loss in EEefficacy. Specifically, Apparate chooses to use frequent thresh-old tuning to preserve accuracy because it provides a finer-grained knob for walking the accuracy-latency tradeoff, i.e.,thresholds are continuous, whereas ramp locations are inher-ently discretized. Thresholds also provide a mechanism tocontrol ramp location; at the extreme, thresholds for any ac-tive ramps can be tuned to preclude exiting. Regardless, tolimit foregone wins from infrequent ramp tuning, Apparateopts to employ many lightweight ramps (§3.1): even if anoptimal ramp is not present yet, a nearby ramp is likely activeand can provide much of the same wins.Implementation details. explanation.summary: Mooncake工作流分离prefill与decoding实例，并把KVCache在CPU和GPU之间以及实例之间传递。左侧复用已有前缀、计算新增cache；右侧收到完整cache后异步加载到GPU进行解码。
elements: 左Prefill Instance内上下分别为GPU和CPU区域，各有Prefix KVCache，粉色Incremental KVCache标新增部分。
s1 KVCache Reuse的虚向上箭头从CPU前缀进入GPU；s2 Incremental Prefill从GPU计算指向新增cache，再向CPU存回。
底部s3 KVCache Transfer长线由左CPU的前缀/增量汇向右CPU Full KVCache。
右Decoding Instance内Full KVCache经Async Load†向上进入GPU，随后s4 Decoding箭头输出；左Layer-wise Load and Store*提示逐层加载/存储。
reading_order: 先读左上GPU的前缀复用与新增prefill，沿s1→s2看cache来源。
转到左CPU层，再跟随底部长线s3到右CPU的Full KVCache，区分跨实例传输和CPU/GPU加载。
最后沿右向上Async Load到GPU，再读s4解码，返回观察逐层/异步标注。
explanation.visual_explanation: 已有前缀可被复用，新增输入形成增量cache，两个部分在左CPU区形成待传输内容。跨实例传输用底部水平线表达，而解码实例CPU到GPU的加载是另一条垂直路径；这避免把prefill计算与decoding生成看成同一GPU上的连续块。左逐层存储、右异步加载的文字说明系统可安排搬运与计算，但静态箭头并未给出精确重叠时序。Full KVCache是解码所需状态，不等同于把模型权重一同迁移。
explanation.takeaway: 图支持KVCache作为prefill/decoding之间状态接口，并区分复用、增量生成、跨实例传输和解码加载四个步骤。
explanation.limits: 脚注*、†的完整条件不在候选内，需原文补足。图无带宽、传输字节、TTFT或token延迟测量，也不画失败恢复与一致性协议；不能仅凭箭头证明传输完全隐藏或任意缓存一定可安全复用。

explanation.summary: PowerInfer图将离线神经元分析与在线CPU/GPU联合推理分开。左侧分析LLM活动特征并划分冷热神经元；右侧按分配加载到两种内存，再在被预测激活的位置执行计算。
elements: 顶部图例：绿Hot、灰Cold、红边Predicated Activation、黄色虚框CPU Core、蓝色虚框GPU SM；红箭头Calculation与蓝箭头Loading区分计算和装载。
左Offline里LLM经编号1进入Profiler&Solver，编号2把混合绿灰神经元划成上方Cold与下方Hot两组。
编号3两条蓝箭头分别把分组结果加载到CPU Mem与GPU Mem，两区由PCIe连接。
右Online的CPU/GPU Executor通过虚线指向计算区，编号4红箭头连接红边激活块与CPU核心/GPU SM。
reading_order: 先用顶图例辨认颜色、红边和箭头，避免把所有灰块读成失效硬件。
沿左侧1→2看神经元画像与划分，再沿3的蓝箭头看数据放到哪种内存。
转到在线两区看红边预测激活、4计算路径及PCIe连接，比较CPU/GPU分工。
explanation.visual_explanation: 离线部分按活动分布给不同神经元分组，绿色频繁活动对象放到GPU一侧，灰色对象放到CPU一侧；这个装载分工用两条蓝箭头连接。在线时红色边框只圈出当前被预测需要计算的一部分块，红箭头把这些对象连接到相应执行资源，强调不必每次处理全部神经元。CPU/GPU Executor是控制计算路径的角色，PCIe是两侧连接，图没有将它画成统一的显存地址空间。预测激活与离线冷热不是同一个判断。
explanation.takeaway: 图展示利用激活稀疏性进行CPU/GPU分工的流程：先离线划分和装载，再在线选择预测激活神经元执行，从而减少不必要的计算对象。
explanation.limits: 冷热划分可能与运行时激活不一致，图面不证明预测总是准确。图无速度、内存容量或传输字节测量，也未展示预测器训练/融合输出的全部实现；不是Context Parallelism图，不能把PCIe连接读成序列分片注意力通信。

fig:sosp2024-powerinfer-fast-large-langu.caption_original: Figure 11. Speedup of various models on PC-Low in FP16 format.The up and down figures represent input length of 64 and128, respectively.with average speedups of 7.23× and 6.19×, and for Falcon-40B, up to 11.69× compared with llama.cpp. Although SpecIn-fer utilizes speculative decoding, since the large model sizeexceeds the GPU’s capacity, there is still a significant amountof swapping during the verify phase, accounting for over95% of the time. As a result, SpecInfer does not significantlyoutperform llama.cpp. The performance superiority of Pow-erInfer becomes more pronounced as the number of outputtokens increases since the generation phase plays a moresignificant role in the overall inference time. In this phase, asmall number of neurons are activated on both CPU and GPU,leading to fewer unnecessary computations compared tollama.cpp. For example, in the case of OPT-30B, only around20% of neurons are activated for each token generated, withthe majority processed on the GPU, a benefit of PowerInfer’sneuron-aware inference engine.Figure 11 shows that on a lower-end PC (PC-Low), Pow-erInfer still attains considerable performance enhancementover llama.cpp and SpecInfer, averaging a speedup of 4.71×,5.97× and peaking at 7.06× and 7.47×. However, these im-provements are smaller compared to those on a higher-endPC (PC-High), primarily due to the 11GB GPU memory limi-tation of PC-Low. This limitation affects the number of neu-rons that can be allocated to the GPU, particularly for modelswith around 30B parameters or more, leading to a greaterdependence on the CPU for processing a larger number ofactivated neurons.

elements: (a)I层是add、fma、mul，U层是u1/u2，P层是p1/p2；I到U的边有数量1/2，U到P的连边说明可执行端口。
fma连接两个u1和一个u2，mul连接一个u2；u1可走p1或p2，而u2只连p2。
(b)p1柱中橙斜纹u1(fma)占两单位，p2柱下两单位是青纹u2(mul)，上部一单位橙纹u2(fma)。

explanation.summary: 图解释3L-Cache从队列头部和尾部两个方向组织采样，形成待淘汰候选，同时维护新对象记录与缓存队列中的移动。候选保留了全部框外条件、插入和淘汰箭头，所以能够区分候选产生与对象真正离开缓存这两个步骤。
elements: 下方紫色Cache queue从Head延伸到Tail，内部标Hit；新对象通过Insert进入头部，Hit对应的长Move箭头返回头部方向。
上方Recorded queue接收New obj的虚线Insert记录，括号条件写Cache size≤Q%；Sampling from the head指向Eviction candidates。
尾部上方标有X%范围和All sampling，Sampling from the tail黑箭头指向左，蓝虚箭头从缓存区域连到候选集合。
Reset在队列内标记采样位置重置，Evict箭头从尾部候选对象移出；虚线叉号对象表示示意中的被选/移除项。
reading_order: 先读Cache queue的头、命中位置和尾，跟踪New obj插入及Hit后的Move路径。
再向上读Recorded queue与头采样，回到尾部X%区域看尾采样如何提供候选，最后沿Evict区分候选形成和实际淘汰。
explanation.visual_explanation: 两路采样并列处理不同位置的对象：头路借助新对象记录，尾路围绕缓存队列较后部的位置进行遍历。候选集合独立置于右上，蓝连接线显示它来自采样而不是对象直接写入缓存；Evict则画在缓存队列外，表示淘汰动作的另一个环节。Q%与X%约束被保留在相关区域，不能把它们写成所有对象都无条件采样。Reset和Move体现队列状态与采样位置会变化，而非一次性静态挑选。
explanation.takeaway: 可见机制是把新到对象记录、队列尾部采样、命中后移动及淘汰候选组织在同一策略中，候选图足以说明双向采样的结构关系。
explanation.limits: 没有预测模型、采样率实值或命中率评测，不能据图判定淘汰最优性。颜色仅为示意区分，Q%/X%不是给定测量值，图也未展开后续如何从候选中计算最终淘汰数量。
explanation.model: Codex native visual reviewer；任务内机器续审，非人类独立复审

elements: 下左Anon Pages in Buddy System矩形内有多色页块，编号1向上进入FSG的Items；编号2把Items转向Transactions。

explanation.takeaway: 图支持把页关联信息与回收压缩结合的系统分层，以及逐页路径和关联页路径共用压缩引擎/存储区域的结构。
explanation.limits: FSG、FT-List、ACR的全称与紧急策略需整页正文补足，候选不是完整算法。颜色没有独立语义图例，不能从颜色推断页热度、压缩率或设备故障；图无时间/空间测量，不能量化内存节省或性能提升。

fig:sosp2024-reducing-energy-bloat-in-la.caption_original: Figure 6. A simplified example of how to reduce iteration time by unit time 𝜏. Given a 1F1B pipeline schedule with 2 stagesand 3 microbatches ( 1 ), it is first transformed to an equivalent representation of computation DAG ( 2 ). Then the CriticalDAG ( 3 ) is obtained by considering only the computations on the critical path. Our key observation is that any valid s-t cuton the Critical DAG will reduce the iteration time by unit time 𝜏. Cut A and Cut B are two examples of valid s-t cuts ( 4 ).Either reducing the one computation associated with Cut A (5A) or reducing the two computations associated with Cut B (5B)reduces the iteration time by 𝜏.

elements: Application与Model、Cloud Storage/Cloud VM位于顶层，save、load、deploy和instance +/-箭头区分模型存取和资源变化。

Parallelization Controller→Device Mapper→Migration Planner以parallel config与device mapping相连，migration plan从规划器返回控制器。
下层Inference Engine中有Context Daemon与Interruption Arranger，后者与GPU图标并置；多个Spot GPU框与省略号表示实例群。
服务器向下输出migration instruction，上下input request/output response构成请求服务路径。
reading_order: 先按顶层请求与部署箭头读云入口，再看CPU服务器三manager。

按元组末尾的1跟踪a→c及a→d的完整分片发送，再按2跟踪c→b的C1和d→b的C2；最后区分粗标注路径与未逐条标注的反向边。
explanation.visual_explanation: 第一步让c和d都持有a的完整S，第二步却不重复发送整片，而是由两支路分别发送C1和C2，使b收齐两个半块。元组同时绑定数据来源、实际链路和通信步骤，恢复左右元组对解释两条支路尤其必要。图中来自a的路径是allgather整体的一部分；整页图注指出其他节点可进行类似广播，但候选未逐一展开这些同时传输，不能把图误称成仅有一个源的完整allgather全流量表。
explanation.takeaway: 可见机制是利用两条支路把分片复制与半块汇集分成两步，并以显式元组描述发送内容及执行阶段；这有助于理解拓扑和调度怎样一起决定通信安排。
explanation.limits: 图没有链路速率、包大小或时间测量，不能直接验证带宽最优性或读取实际耗时。细边只展示连接方向，其他源的完整调度、冲突处理及外图注性能公式均不在候选中。

explanation.visual_explanation: 消息写动作和载荷，参与者按职责排列；把全流程持续时间和交接影响分开标界，可避免读者把后台准备时间误读为全部用户中断。
explanation.takeaway: 借用参与者列、编号事件、消息载荷和双范围标注表达迁移、切换或滚动恢复；明确哪个阶段在后台完成、哪个阶段影响服务。
explanation.limits: 箭头间距不是测量时间，图本身不证明中断时长；KV cache只在正文说明被重算，不能说图画了直接KV缓存传输。循环多轮没有在图中完全展开，失败/任务提前结束处置需后文，图内也未体现context/data/pipeline parallelism。
